subject: Catalyst Labs hackweek: credit allocation and mentor onboarding
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna@catalystlabs.org>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mentor credits + trial extension for Catalyst Labs hackweek

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick product intro last week — the demo was great. We're running our annual Catalyst Labs hackweek (July 12–16) and have ~180 attendees across student and early-stage OSS maintainer tracks. A few asks from the program team: 

- Can Redwood provide a promo credit pool (GPU + hosted inference) to cover 10 mentor teams and 30 finalist projects (~ equivalent of $6k–8k in credits)?
- Would you consider a short trial extension for selected maintainers so they can migrate small model demos to Redwood Dedicated for the event?
- We also need a simple onboarding plan and a mentor roster we can share — high-touch for mentor leads, self-serve for students.

We've attached a short scope doc (catalyst-hackweek-scope.pdf) and a draft mentor roster. Our decision deadline for communications is Tue 22 Jun EOD.

If helpful, we can jump on a 30-min sync Monday.

Appreciate it —
Anna
Program Director, Catalyst Labs
anna@catalystlabs.org

Attachments: catalyst-hackweek-scope.pdf (application/pdf), mentor-roster.csv (text/csv)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Request: mentor credits + trial extension for Catalyst Labs hackweek

Hi Anna — thanks, and congrats on pulling the program together. We're interested in supporting this. Quick answers up front:

- Promo credits: we can provision a $7k pooled promo credit applied to your HubSpot account (HUBSPOT-2345678). That will be split across mentor pools + finalist demos; we'll provide a redemption link for each organizer.
- Trial extensions: we can grant 60-day trial extensions to up to 12 maintainers/fellow teams for Dedicated evaluation (VPC not included in the trial).
- Onboarding: we can run two 45-min mentor onboarding sessions (July 9 & 11) and provide a one-page quickstart and a mentor Slack channel.

To proceed I'll need: a list of the 12 maintainer emails for trial keys, and one point of contact for billing/terms redline (if any). I'll loop in Marissa for fulfillment and Karthik for eligibility review.

If you're ok, let's treat this as a standard community promo package (no custom SLA).

Best,
Logan
Head of Community Programs, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com

Logan / Karthik — quick internal checklist before I approve the promo: 

1) Eligibility: confirm that the maintainer teams are small OSS projects or student teams (no enterprise trials). Will require an email/domain check; ask Anna to provide the 12 maintainer emails.

2) Spend cap: recommend $7k pool with per-redeem cap at $1k; this prevents a single demo from using the full pool. Agree?

3) Trial keys: we can issue 12 Dedicated trial keys limited to 8 vCPUs / 1 x A10G equiv for 60 days. Must include TOS acknowledgement and usage guidance (no production traffic).

4) Tracking: create a shared Drive folder and a simple spreadsheet to track redemptions and contact info (I've created folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_catalyst_hackweek_plans).

If you both sign off I'll create the HubSpot promo code, generate the trial keys, and schedule the mentor onboarding invites.

—Marissa
